title: Pereboom: the proposal is fragile because its properties are barely conceived

statements.text: Absolutely intrinsic properties of the protophenomenal sort are at best minimally conceived, and Pereboom places the fragility of his proposal there. Its advantage is that it can keep the claim that introspection represents phenomenal properties as having the qualitative natures they in fact have.

sources.quote: Absolutely intrinsic properties of this protophenomenal sort are currently at best only minimally conceived, and herein lies the fragility of the proposal.
it can clearly accept an attractive accuracy claim about phenomenal representation
